Crtx 273305 migrate azure resource graph (#46070)

* feat(Azure): migrate Azure Resource Graph commands to COOC unified Azure integration

Migrate azure-rg-list-operations and azure-rg-query from the legacy
AzureResourceGraph pack into the unified COOC Azure integration, following
the Azure Storage migration pattern (two-layer AzureClient method + command
function, handle_azure_error, permission-tracking dicts).

- Add resource_graph_list_operations / resource_graph_query_resources client methods
- Add command functions with unified Azure.ResourceGraph.* output prefixes
- Register commands and ResourceGraph permissions
- Add YAML command blocks and migrated unit tests + test data

* fix(Azure): keep Azure.yml change additive - only add resource graph commands

Revert the demisto-sdk format whole-file reindentation of Azure.yml and keep
only the additive azure-rg-list-operations and azure-rg-query command blocks,
so the YAML diff contains no unrelated deletions.

* fix(Azure): add subscription_id arg to resource graph commands

main() resolves the account via get_from_args_or_params(key=subscription_id)
on the Cortex Platform connector path before dispatch, so azure-rg-list-operations
and azure-rg-query need subscription_id available. Add it as an optional arg
(required on the platform path), matching the other Azure commands. Verified all
command examples pass end-to-end against the live tenant.

* fix ruff

* Align Azure Resource Graph commands with PR review feedback

- Surface API $skipToken as Azure.ResourceGraph.QueryNextToken (context + readable output)
- Add next_token argument to azure-rg-query for customer-driven pagination
- Use tableToMarkdown headers (id, name, type) instead of restructuring for HR
- Validate paging args via shared validate_limit helper
- Bump Resource Graph API version to latest GA 2024-04-01
- Update unit tests for keyed-dict outputs and next_token surfacing

* Address code-review findings for Azure Resource Graph commands

- Add release note (1.9.0) documenting the two migrated RG commands; bump pack version
- Enforce documented default limit of 50 in azure-rg-query unbounded fetch
- Return explicit 'no results' readable output for both commands when empty
- Update unit tests for the empty-results behavior

* Address AI reviewer comments on Azure Resource Graph commands

- Fix $skip off-by-one in azure-rg-query paging (page 1 now skips 0)
- Make RG query mock fixtures consistent (count/totalRecords, id matches name) and obviously mock (mock-subscription-id, MOCK-RESOURCE-GROUP)
- Declare numeric paging args as type: Number; move query limit default to defaultValue field
- End query argument description with a period
- Reword isArray argument descriptions to 'A comma-separated list of...'

* Add README docs for azure-rg-list-operations and azure-rg-query (RM110)

* Address Julia's doc review comments on Azure Resource Graph commands

* Address masulin97 review comments on Azure Resource Graph commands

- Raise RESOURCE_GRAPH_MAX_PAGE_SIZE to 1000 per the Resource Graph paging docs.
- Remove client-side limit/page/page_size from azure-rg-list-operations (API does not support paging).
- Send limit to the query API as $top instead of slicing client-side; drop the fetch-all loop.
- Validate page as a positive integer instead of capping it at BLOB_CONTAINERS_MAX_PAGE_SIZE.
- Build the query request body with remove_empty_elements().
- Update YAML, README, and unit tests accordingly.
